title: Flattening paired decoding rounds
statement: Let $c$ be any function from pairs of finite bit strings to finite bit strings, and let $N$ be a natural number. For finite bit strings $u,v$ with $|u|\le N$, consider each $i=0,\ldots,N-1$: if either string obtained by applying the total second projection $i$ times to $u$ and $v$, respectively, is empty, contribute nothing; otherwise apply $c$ to the total first projections of those two strings. The concatenation of these contributions equals the concatenation of $c$ applied to corresponding terms of the recursively decoded-word lists of $u$ and $v$, stopping when either list runs out.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ maps pairs of finite bit strings to a finite bit string
